name: Simple Civilian Behaviour
scope: Complete108-line XEH_preInit.sqf, AI entry/init and player-action callback declarations config.cpp658-705; animation state declarations sampled only. No RTM/gesture playback or full movement-state graph evaluation. Not whole visual/effective-addon parity.
sourceIntent: Unarmed civilian fear, indoor/outdoor reactions, response to nearby fire/pass-by/hit, optional escape in a civilian car, and player stop/disperse interactions.
dispositions: LoadCivilian excludes player/dead/captive/armed actors, disables FSM/AUTOCOMBAT/AUTOTARGET/COVER/TARGET, sets CARELESS/LIMITED and source-specific LAMBS exclusions. CBE retains mission/native capability and specialist authority rather than unconditionally replacing these settings.

Suppressed within30m (excluding self-instigator), FiredNear, Hit, vehicle Hit and GetOutMan trigger reactions/poses. Adapt the missing native projectile pass-by input through existing finite civilian ownership; do not copy duplicate vehicle handlers or world-wide animation/radio broadcasts.

Flee sets a public Scared flag with no reset in the reviewed body. Forced stop/flee change PATH, posture, behaviour and group pace without captured restoration. CBE repeat generations/deadlines/cooldowns and newer-order priority remain authoritative.

Indoor fear forces a custom prone/crouch animation, while outdoor fear claims cars or chooses random800-2000m escapes/group waypoints. Keep contextual survival intent as an open capability; no scripted poses, vehicle claims or distant group-waypoint replacement imported.

FindNearestCar checks IsTakenByCivie on candidate cars but sets it on the civilian. It does not check an empty driver, current vehicle owner or mobility before claiming CIV_F. Do not import the mismatched claim or automatic commandeering. Civilian vehicle escape remains unimplemented.

Player stop/disperse actions call forced functions on the actor owner and play gestures. They are not implemented by this autonomous event addition; future explicit operator tasks need their own authoritative intent and lifecycle. Existing compatibility-only Droids/Zombies scope is unchanged; this is a distinct registered civilian reference.
implementation: CortexCivilianSetup installs/removes one owner-local Suppressed handler in its existing ID registry. Pass-by distance must be finite/nonnegative and within min(configured radius,30m), self-shot/instigator refused. Only current projectile velocity provides an inferred upstream threat point; no distant shooter/instigator position is queried. Missing/invalid velocity uses the existing local-danger fallback. Existing CortexCivilianReact receives SUPPRESSED priority2, below hit3/above FiredNear1, so cooldown/generation and finite observation/retry rules coalesce rounds. No new controller, reveal, pose, settings ownership, scan or vehicle claim.

engineReference.facts: Suppressed available since1.58, local, supplies projectile-pass distance/shooter/instigator/ammo object; native enemy-side/ammo suppression rules control delivery. No allegiance manipulation added.
engineReference.limit: Neutral/same-side projectiles may not trigger it. This does not guarantee universal civilian pass-by detection.

cost: One additional native EH per installed civilian, cheap distance/identity/velocity work per delivered event. Geometry only through existing admitted reaction after ownership/cooldown checks; no world scan/worker. Dense-fire event overhead unmeasured.
limits: Actual civilian event delivery under mission side/ammo rules, escape direction/flow, repeated fire, migration/removal and runtime cost unverified.
Contextual shelter, body/scream awareness, civilian vehicle escape and operator interactions remain open; no whole-source parity or percentage uplift.
